# Julian Jakob

> Julian Jakob is an Austrian brand designer based in Salzburg who builds flexible brand systems — identities that connect strategy, visual identity and implementation and keep evolving as a company grows. He has contributed to sub-brands and campaigns for Spotify, Meta and Sony Music, and has won two Cannes Lions. Website: https://julianjakob.at

Julian works full-time as a digital brand designer at LOOP (https://www.agentur-loop.com/) and takes on a small number of freelance projects each year for selected companies and individuals. He presents his full portfolio in person or on a call rather than as public case studies; the website shows a feed of project snapshots.

## Career

- LOOP — Digital Brand Designer (since 2026). Team page: https://www.agentur-loop.com/about
- Studio Herrström — Junior Designer (2024–2026): concepting and design execution for clients including Spotify, Meta, Sony Music and Red Bull; presented creative work to stakeholders. https://www.studioherrstrom.com/about
- Freelance brand designer (since 2022): a handful of projects each year for selected companies and individuals.
- Education: Graphic & Information Design at New Design University (NDU), St. Pölten (2021–2024), specialising in Integrated Campaigns and Brand Design, graduated with excellence; Erasmus exchange at ESADA, Spain (2022–2023); Handelsakademie (business school) Matura (2015–2020).

## Approach

Most brand problems are clarity problems, not design problems. Every project follows four steps:

1. Research — stakeholder workshops, competitive analysis and audience analysis to define what is needed and why.
2. Construct — positioning, brand strategy and messaging translated into a clear brand architecture.
3. Deliver — naming, visual identity and design system for launches, refreshes or pivots.
4. Implement — campaigns, digital applications and editorial design that carry the identity without dilution.

Every project is scoped individually. For larger scopes Julian brings in a curated network of specialists (strategists, copywriters, motion designers, developers). He aims for long-term partnerships.
